title: Explore the Unknown Dungeon
description: Enter a C-Rank dungeon and survey the area without combat.
story: Whispers echo through the hunter guild hall about a newly discovered C-Rank dungeon nestled in the outskirts of the city. The Association has marked it for reconnaissance — a perfect mission for someone still finding their footing. You stand at the entrance, the air thick with mana and the scent of damp stone. Shadows dance along the walls, cast by bioluminescent moss that pulses with an eerie green light. Your heart pounds as you take your first step inside. The System warns you: survey only, do not engage. But the temptation to draw your weapon nags at the edge of your mind. Every corner could hide treasure or terror. You move silently, mapping the layout, noting the strange symbols etched into the walls — a language older than any known civilization. This dungeon holds secrets, and the System wants you to find them. Your footsteps echo in the silence as you press deeper into the unknown. The hunters who came before you either returned with glory... or did not return at all.
